title: fix round for T-1726: two gate failures after the tick snapshot refactor (test_once_skips_ship, test_handover writes)
spec:
T-1726's gate (wt/T-1726/.orchestrator/runs/tests/T-1726-20261008-103013.log) failed on two tests:
1. tests/test_ship.py Ship.test_once_skips_ship asserts that the source of daemon.tick contains 'ship_tick(pool, stop_event)'.
   T-1726 moved the stage body into _tick() and tick() now wraps it in bus.snapshot(). Keep the behaviour the test guards
   (daemon --once must not start a ship thread; the CLI daemon does) and update the test to inspect _tick (or, better,
   assert the behaviour instead of source text). Do not move ship_tick back into tick.
2. tests/test_handover.py Handover.test_unchanged_state_writes_nothing: AssertionError 3 != 2 (writes counted). Find
   whether T-1726's snapshot/archive path adds a write when state is unchanged (e.g. the snapshot flushing or archive
   touching a file each tick). Fix the code so an unchanged state writes nothing extra; do not loosen the test.
Run in wt/T-1726: PYTHONPATH=tests uv run python -m unittest tests.test_ship tests.test_handover tests.test_bus tests.test_daemon.
Commit on task/T-1726.
acceptance: test_once_skips_ship passes and still guards that --once never starts a ship thread
